travel_points <- rbind(
  travel_points,
  data.frame(
    place = "UCSB",
    lat = 34.4140,
    lon = -119.8489,
    region = "School"
  )
)

travel_points <- rbind(
  travel_points,
  data.frame(
    place = "WashU",
    lat = 38.6489,
    lon = -90.3125,
    region = "School"
  )
)

# Create custom icons
home_icon <- makeAwesomeIcon(
  icon = 'home', markerColor = 'blue', iconColor = 'white', library = 'fa'
)
school_icon <- makeAwesomeIcon(
  icon = 'university', markerColor = "purple", iconColor = 'white', library = 'fa'
)
# Build the map
leaflet(travel_points) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
  # Add circle markers for all except Home and UCSB
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = subset(travel_points, place != "San Francisco, California" & place != "UCSB" & place != "WashU"),
    ~lon, ~lat,
    fillColor = "red",
    color = "white",
    radius = 6,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = ~paste0("<strong>", place, "</strong>"),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(),
    group = "places"  # group name for search
  ) %>%
  # Add the home icon
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    data = subset(travel_points, place == "San Francisco, California"),
    ~lon, ~lat,
    icon = home_icon,
    popup = ~paste0("<strong>Home: ", place, "</strong>")
  ) %>%
  # Add the school icon for UCSB
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    data = subset(travel_points, place == "UCSB"),
    ~lon, ~lat,
    icon = school_icon,
    popup = ~paste0("<strong>School: ", place, "</strong>")
  ) %>%
   addAwesomeMarkers(
    data = subset(travel_points, place == "WashU"),
    ~lon, ~lat,
    icon = school_icon,
    popup = ~paste0("<strong>School: ", place, "</strong>")
  ) %>%
    # Add reset view button
  addEasyButton(
    easyButton(
      icon = "fa-globe", title = "Reset View",
      onClick = JS("function(btn, map){ map.setView([20, 0], 2); }")
    )
  )
